subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this Debug Snapshots bug, or clear it and queue a fresh current-main OpenClaw fix?
rationale: The issue is still valid, but a closing fork PR points at the same work while the previous same-repo PR was closed unmerged, so automation should not open another fix until maintainers choose the branch path.

options.title: Queue a fresh current-main fix
options.body: Ignore or close out the fork-only candidate and promote a narrow target-repo fix that follows the current Debug page/view/i18n structure.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Review the open fork PR as the source candidate, requiring a current-main rebase, localized copy, layout preservation, tests, and real UI proof before merge.

options.title: Leave waiting on the fork
options.body: Keep this issue parked behind the fork PR, accepting that no fresh OpenClaw fix lane should start yet.

recommendation.title: Queue a fresh current-main fix
recommendation.body: Ignore or close out the fork-only candidate and promote a narrow target-repo fix that follows the current Debug page/view/i18n structure.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Control dashboard Debug surface appears to have been introduced by steipete, making him the best available routing owner for the branch-path decision.
